===Defeated===
* Motion to censure proxy Hercynia (proposed by Redoubt, seconded by Miaren) defeated by 22 votes to 3.
* Motion to resupply the army of the Golden Axe (proposed by ''illegible'', seconded by Feroz), defeated by 22 votes to 5.
* Motion to outlaw raiding against the Jotun during the ceasefire (proposed by Tassato, seconded by Therunin), defeated 22 votes to 5.
* Motion to declare Jotun foreigners during ceasefire (proposed Mitwold, seconded Upwold), defeated 27 votes to 0
